MMLCA: an R package for the identification and characterization of multimorbidity patterns using latent class analysis

MMLCA aims to simplify the identification of multimorbidity patterns through user-friendly functions. Leveraging the power of Latent Class Analysis (LCA) as implemented in the poLCA package, MMLCA provides an accessible and efficient tool for researchers.

Installation

You can install the development version of MMLCA from GitHub with:

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("ARCbiostat/MMLCA")

Tutorial

A paper tutorial will be soon out, stay tuned!

Citation

To cite MMLCA in publications use:

Gregorio C., Luo H., Beridze G., Damiano C., Ornago A.M., Triolo F., Calderón-Larrañaga A., Vetrano D.L. (2026). MMLCA: an R package for the identification and characterization of multimorbidity patterns using latent class analysis. R package version: 2.0 https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA
